verdict.rationale: Apify offers a CLI (apify-docs-3, apify-probe-4), REST API with OpenAPI spec (apify-probe-2), JS/Python SDKs and API clients for scripted/programmatic runs (apify-docs-15, apify-docs-16, apify-docs-24), scheduling for automated runs (apify-docs-6), webhooks for chaining automation (apify-docs-14, apify-docs-29), and Docker base images enabling containerized/CI execution (apify-docs-30). This collectively demonstrates headless/CI-friendly operation. Missing for 10: explicit first-party CI/CD integration guide (e.g., GitHub Actions example) and independent hands-on confirmation of running Actors inside a CI pipeline.
